title: Death Valley Long Weekend
subtitle: Presidents Day · Feb 12–15, 2027. Beatty, Death Valley and Manzanar on Saturday, then a round trip to Hole-in-the-Wall for Mojave and Castle Mountains on Sunday.

days.title: Fly to Las Vegas
days.html:
✈︎

OAK → LAS after work

Southwest WN 828 · OAK 8:05 PM → LAS 9:40 PM, nonstop. Conf. B7SZDK.

Take the shuttle to the Rent-A-Car Center and pick up the round-trip car (Costco Travel). Then the Best Western Plus Casino Royale, 3411 Las Vegas Blvd S, Center Strip: free parking, no resort fee, one hotel for all three nights.

Navigate to hotel ↗
Before bed: download offline maps. Cell service is spotty or absent in both parks. Tomorrow starts at 7:00.

days.title: Beatty, across the valley, to Manzanar
days.sub: Beatty → Death Valley → Lone Pine → Manzanar → back to Vegas
days.cut: Manzanar’s visitor center closes at 4:30; if the morning runs late, skip Harmony Borax and the dunes. Towne Pass can get snow in February, and the drive back is mostly after dark.

days.title: Round trip to the Mojave
days.cut: No food or gas inside Mojave National Preserve. Stay on the paved Essex Road side both ways; don’t follow GPS onto the dirt roads north of Hole-in-the-Wall.

stops.via: US-95 N, about 120 mi. Grab breakfast on the way out.
stops.name: Beatty, NV

bonus.title: Check first · Beatty Information Center
bonus.where: Older park listings show an NPS info center here, but current NPS hours pages don’t list it. Check the NPS app before you go.

stops.note: Either way, it’s the last cheap gas and a restroom stop before the park.

stops.via: NV-374 over Daylight Pass → Beatty Cutoff → CA-190.
stops.name: Death Valley NP
stops.addr: Furnace Creek Visitor Center, Death Valley, CA
stops.hrs: Daily 8:00–5:00. Museum and park film inside.
stops.ok: One closer on the 64 national parks list. Bonus Death Valley cancellations at Stovepipe Wells and Lone Pine later today.
stops.about: The hottest, driest and lowest national park. Badwater Basin sits 282 feet below sea level, and it’s the largest national park outside Alaska.

stops.name: Harmony Borax Works
stops.addr: Harmony Borax Works, Death Valley, CA
stops.note: Short paved path past the ruins and a 20-mule-team wagon.

stops.name: Mesquite Flat Sand Dunes
stops.addr: Mesquite Flat Sand Dunes, Death Valley, CA
stops.note: View the dunes from the parking lot.

stops.name: Stovepipe Wells
stops.note: Lunch at the Toll Road Restaurant, then top off the tank. It’s the last gas before Lone Pine.

stops.name: Father Crowley Vista Point
stops.note: Paved lot overlooking Rainbow Canyon, your last big Death Valley view.
stops.warn: Towne Pass climbs to about 5,000 ft and can get snow in February. Check road conditions that morning.

stops.name: Eastern Sierra InterAgency Visitor Center
stops.addr: Eastern Sierra Interagency Visitor Center, Lone Pine, CA

bonus.title: Bonus cancellation · extra Death Valley stamp

stops.note: Right where CA-136 meets US-395, with your first full view of Mt. Whitney.

stops.name: Manzanar NHS
stops.addr: Manzanar National Historic Site, 5001 US-395, Independence, CA 93526
stops.warn: The visitor center closes at 4:30. If the morning runs late, skip Harmony Borax and the dunes rather than this stop.
stops.ok: Visitor center first for the stamp and exhibits, then the Block 14 barracks and mess hall next door.
stops.about: One of ten camps where Japanese Americans were incarcerated during World War II. More than 10,000 people lived here behind barbed wire.

stops.name: Early dinner in Lone Pine
stops.note: Eat and fill the tank before the long drive back. Sunset is around 5:30, so you’ll catch the Sierra turning pink as you head out.

stops.via: Most of this is after dark and crosses Towne Pass. Check road conditions before you leave Lone Pine.
stops.name: Las Vegas
stops.addr: Best Western Plus Casino Royale, 3411 Las Vegas Blvd S, Las Vegas, NV
stops.note: Back at the Best Western Plus Casino Royale, same hotel as Friday. Sleep in tomorrow.

stops.via: US-95 S through Searchlight → I-40 W → Essex Rd → Black Canyon Rd. Pick up lunch to go and fill the tank first.
stops.name: Mojave NPres + Castle Mountains NM
stops.addr: Hole-in-the-Wall Information Center, Mojave National Preserve
stops.where: Stamp kiosk on the front porch
stops.hrs: Open 24/7, so it works even if the building is closed

also.name: Castle Mountains NM
also.where: Same porch kiosk. Castle Mountains has no visitor center of its own.

stops.warn: Come in and leave on the paved Essex Road side. NPS warns not to follow GPS onto the dirt roads north of here, even though they look shorter to Vegas.
stops.ok: Picnic lunch with a view of the pocked volcanic walls of Banshee Canyon. The Rings Loop climbs with metal rings, so skip it.
stops.about: Mojave National Preserve covers 1.6 million acres of desert between I-15 and I-40. Castle Mountains, next door, became a national monument in 2016.

stops.via: Black Canyon Rd → Essex Rd → I-40 E → US-95 N.
stops.name: Las Vegas
stops.addr: Best Western Plus Casino Royale, 3411 Las Vegas Blvd S, Las Vegas, NV
stops.note: Back at the Best Western Plus Casino Royale. Evening free in Vegas. Tomorrow: check out at 5:15 AM.

stops.via: Check out and return the car. The LAS Rent-A-Car Center is off-airport, so allow about 20 minutes for the shuttle to the terminal.
stops.title: Las Vegas → home
stops.note: Southwest WN 504 · LAS 7:15 AM → OAK 8:50 AM, nonstop. Conf. B7SZDK. Home with the holiday still ahead of you.
